versos.hebraico: גַּם־אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁלֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶ֝עְתִּ֗יקוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י׀ חִזְקִיָּ֬ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
controles.kjv: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
controles.livre: Estes também são provérbios de Salomão, que foram copiados pelos homens de Ezequias, rei de Judá.

versos.hebraico: כְּבֹ֣ד אֱ֭לֹהִים הַסְתֵּ֣ר דָּבָ֑ר וּכְבֹ֥ד מְ֝לָכִ֗ים חֲקֹ֣ר דָּבָֽר׃

controles.web: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
controles.kjv: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
controles.livre: É glória de Deus encobrir alguma coisa; mas a glória dos Reis é investigá-la.

versos.hebraico: שָׁמַ֣יִם לָ֭רוּם וָאָ֣רֶץ לָעֹ֑מֶק וְלֵ֥ב מְ֝לָכִ֗ים אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃

controles.web: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
controles.kjv: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
controles.livre: Para a altura dos céus, para a profundeza da terra, assim como para o coração dos reis, não há como serem investigados.

versos.hebraico: הָג֣וֹ סִיגִ֣ים מִכָּ֑סֶף וַיֵּצֵ֖א לַצֹּרֵ֣ף כֶּֽלִי׃

controles.web: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner;
controles.kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
controles.livre: Tira as escórias da prata, e sairá um vaso para o fundidor.

versos.hebraico: הָג֣וֹ רָ֭שָׁע לִפְנֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְיִכּ֖וֹן בַּצֶּ֣דֶק כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
controles.kjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
controles.livre: Tira o perverso de diante do rei, e seu trono se firmará com justiça.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּתְהַדַּ֥ר לִפְנֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבִמְק֥וֹם גְּ֝דֹלִ֗ים אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹֽד׃

controles.web: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
controles.kjv: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
controles.livre: Não honres a ti mesmo perante o rei, nem te ponhas no lugar dos grandes;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י ט֥וֹב אֲמָר־לְךָ֗ עֲֽלֵ֫ה הֵ֥נָּה מֵֽ֭הַשְׁפִּ֣ילְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י נָדִ֑יב אֲשֶׁ֖ר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
controles.kjv: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
controles.livre: Porque é melhor que te digam: Sobe aqui;Do que te rebaixem perante a face do príncipe, a quem teus olhos viram.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֵּצֵ֥א לָרִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה־תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָ֑הּ בְּהַכְלִ֖ים אֹתְךָ֣ רֵעֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
controles.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
controles.livre: Não sejas apressado para entrar numa disputa; senão, o que farás se no fim teu próximo te envergonhar?

versos.hebraico: רִֽ֭יבְךָ רִ֣יב אֶת־רֵעֶ֑ךָ וְס֖וֹד אַחֵ֣ר אַל־תְּגָֽל׃

controles.web: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another;
controles.kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
controles.livre: Disputa tua causa com teu próximo, mas não reveles segredo de outra pessoa.

versos.hebraico: פֶּֽן־יְחַסֶּדְךָ֥ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְ֝דִבָּתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תָשֽׁוּב׃

controles.web: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
controles.kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
controles.livre: Para que não te envergonhe aquele que ouvir; pois tua má fama não pode ser desfeita.

versos.hebraico: תַּפּוּחֵ֣י זָ֭הָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת כָּ֑סֶף דָּ֝בָ֗ר דָּבֻ֥ר עַל־אָפְנָֽיו׃

controles.web: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
controles.kjv: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
controles.livre: A palavra dita em tempo apropriado é como maçãs de ouro em bandejas de prata.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב וַחֲלִי־כָ֑תֶם מוֹכִ֥יחַ חָ֝כָ֗ם עַל־אֹ֥זֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת׃

controles.web: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
controles.kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
controles.livre: O sábio que repreende junto a um ouvido disposto a escutar é como pendentes de ouro e ornamentos de ouro refinado.

versos.hebraico: כְּצִנַּת־שֶׁ֨לֶג׀ בְּי֬וֹם קָצִ֗יר צִ֣יר נֶ֭אֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָ֑יו וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲדֹנָ֣יו יָשִֽׁיב׃פ

controles.web: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
controles.kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
controles.livre: Como frio de neve no tempo da colheita, assim é o mensageiro fiel para aqueles que o enviam; porque ele refresca a alma de seus senhores.

versos.hebraico: נְשִׂיאִ֣ים וְ֭רוּחַ וְגֶ֣שֶׁם אָ֑יִן אִ֥ישׁ מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ל בְּמַתַּת־שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
controles.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
controles.livre: Como nuvens e ventos que não trazem chuva, assim é o homem que se orgulha de falsos presentes.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְלָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבָּר־גָּֽרֶם׃

controles.web: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
controles.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
controles.livre: Com paciência para não se irar é que se convence um líder; e a língua suave quebra ossos.

versos.hebraico: דְּבַ֣שׁ מָ֭צָאתָ אֱכֹ֣ל דַּיֶּ֑ךָּ פֶּן־תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
controles.kjv: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
controles.livre: Achaste mel? Come o que te for suficiente; para que não venhas a ficar cheio demais, e vomites.

versos.hebraico: הֹקַ֣ר רַ֭גְלְךָ מִבֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ פֶּן־יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
controles.kjv: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
controles.livre: Não exagere teus pés na casa de teu próximo, para que ele não se canse de ti, e te odeie.

versos.hebraico: מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭חֶרֶב וְחֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
controles.kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
controles.livre: Martelo, espada e flecha afiada é o homem que fala falso testemunho contra seu próximo.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֣ן רֹ֭עָה וְרֶ֣גֶל מוּעָ֑דֶת מִבְטָ֥ח בּ֝וֹגֵ֗ד בְּי֣וֹם צָרָֽה׃

controles.web: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth, or a lame foot.
controles.kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
controles.livre: Confiar num infiel no tempo de angústia é como um dente quebrado ou um pé sem firmeza.

versos.hebraico: מַ֥עֲדֶה בֶּ֨גֶד׀ בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל־נָ֑תֶר וְשָׁ֥ר בַּ֝שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב־רָֽע׃פ

controles.web: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
controles.kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
controles.livre: Quem canta canções ao coração aflito é como aquele que tira a roupa num dia frio, ou como vinagre sobre salitre.

versos.hebraico: אִם־רָעֵ֣ב שֹׂ֭נַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵ֣הוּ לָ֑חֶם וְאִם־צָ֝מֵ֗א הַשְׁקֵ֥הוּ מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink:
controles.kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
controles.livre: Se aquele que te odeia tiver fome, dá-lhe pão para comer; e se tiver sede, dá-lhe água para beber;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י גֶֽחָלִ֗ים אַ֭תָּה חֹתֶ֣ה עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יְשַׁלֶּם־לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.
controles.kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee.
controles.livre: Porque assim amontoarás brasas sobre a cabeça dele, e o SENHOR te recompensará.

versos.hebraico: ר֣וּחַ צָ֭פוֹן תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל גָּ֑שֶׁם וּפָנִ֥ים נִ֝זְעָמִ֗ים לְשׁ֣וֹן סָֽתֶר׃

controles.web: The north wind produces rain: so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
controles.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
controles.livre: O vento norte traz a chuva; assim como a língua caluniadora traz a ira no rosto.

versos.hebraico: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מדונים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
controles.kjv: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
controles.livre: É melhor morar num canto do terraço do que com uma mulher briguenta numa casa espaçosa.

versos.hebraico: מַ֣יִם קָ֭רִים עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
controles.kjv: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
controles.livre: Como água refrescante para a alma cansada, assim são boas notícias de uma terra distante.

versos.hebraico: מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּמָק֣וֹר מָשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִפְנֵֽי־רָשָֽׁע׃

controles.web: Like a muddied spring, and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
controles.kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
controles.livre: O justo que se deixa levar pelo perverso é como uma fonte turva e um manancial poluído.

versos.hebraico: אָ֘כֹ֤ל דְּבַ֣שׁ הַרְבּ֣וֹת לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְחֵ֖קֶר כְּבֹדָ֣ם כָּבֽוֹד׃

controles.web: It is not good to eat much honey; nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
controles.kjv: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
controles.livre: Comer muito mel não é bom; assim como buscar muita glória para si.

versos.hebraico: עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְרוּחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
controles.kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
controles.livre: O homem que não pode conter seu espírito é como uma cidade derrubada sem muro.
